A novel magnesium (Mg) doped Co-9Al-4.5W-4.5Mo-2Ta-0.02B alloy (doped 0.1, 0.3, 0.7 and 1.0 at.% Mg, referred to as 0.1Mg, 0.3Mg, 0.7Mg and 1Mg alloys hereafter, respectively)

Button ingots of the Co-9Al-4.5W-4.5Mo-2Ta-0.02B-(0.1, 0.3, 0.7 and 1.0) Mg alloys (referred to as 0.1Mg, 0.3Mg, 0.7Mg and 1Mg alloy, hereafter), each with a mass of 150 grams, were prepared by arc melting five or six times using the vacuum arc melting (VAR) method to homogenize the compositions of the ingots.
The ingots were solution-treated at 1350 °C for 8 h in a vacuum, followed by furnace cooling.
Then, they were sealed in an evacuated quartz capsule back-filled with argon and aged at 800 °C for 50 h, followed by quenching.
